verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own docs say it can read files, analyze data, and summarize findings inside the product. Plugins connect it to work data sources such as Google Drive, SharePoint, Salesforce, and Slack for summaries, and Work turns analysis into finished deliverables. Community users praise file upload and interpretation, though one notes answers can be plausible but wrong and weak on numbers. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of data-analysis workflows and proactive suggestions, and independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality on user data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Search the web, browse websites, compare sources, read files, analyze data, and summarize findings.
